h.periodsInfo: A period sets the mood (calm or dancing), the screen colour, the autopilot song list, guest requests and what Vinny says at the start. Switch between them with the Dinner / Party buttons at the top.

h.ph.jinglePh: E.g.: Ladies and gentlemen, the dance floor is open! (leave empty: Vinny says nothing)
h.ph.openerInfo: When the period starts, the dinner music fades out, this song starts at the chosen spot and fades in, then Vinny says his line over it. To pick the spot: play the song, move with the progress bar, then click “Use the current track and position”.
h.ph.openHere: Use the current track and position
h.ph.searchPh: Search for a song (e.g. Right Here, Right Now)
h.openHereFirst: First play the song (Spotify), move to the right spot, then click here
h.openerSetHint: Opener: {title}. To start somewhere other than the beginning: play it and use “Use the current track and position”
h.op.0: The opening string build is made for this: start at 0, 12 s fade, Vinny talks during the build
h.op.1: Happy piano house, 100% instrumental: start just before the piano comes in
h.op.2: Iconic guitar riff, almost no vocals: start just before the riff
h.op.3: Start in the drum build, just before the riff
h.op.4: Start in the build before the main riff
h.op.5: Start before the synth riff comes in (the spoken part is short)
h.op.6: The arena riff: guaranteed energy, a bit “sports”
h.op.7: Softer, 1996 nostalgia: a good transition after a calm dinner
h.op.8: Younger and harder: start in the build, the drop lands after the announcement
h.autoInfo: When nobody requests anything, Vinny picks from the period’s list and fills the queue up to this number. You can reorder or remove these tracks in the queue.

h.help.file: The next tracks: drag to reorder, guest requests go first.
h.help.file.long: Tracks requested by guests go first, then the “auto” tracks chosen by the autopilot. You can add a track yourself, move it up (⏫), down or remove it. “Requests open” decides whether guests can still request.
h.help.periodes: Dinner or Party: mood, song list, colour and Vinny’s line.
h.help.autopilote: Without requests, Vinny picks from the period’s list on his own.
h.help.ligne: Slip a line dance into the queue, on demand or at intervals.
h.help.ligne.long: The button puts the next line dance at the front of the queue. The menu can start one automatically every 20, 30 or 45 minutes. The tracks come from the line dance list below.
h.help.boutons: Effects, jingles and Vinny’s messages, in one click.
h.help.boutons.long: Announce the next track = Vinny introduces it out loud. Period line = Vinny repeats his opening line. Confetti and Party mode act on the party screen. The field at the bottom makes Vinny say any message (e.g. “Dinner is served!”).
h.help.annonces: Vinny announces requests; QR reminder setting.
h.help.annonces.long: Voice announcements: Vinny announces requested tracks and line dances. Animations and jingles: automatic confetti, party mode and “ding” on every request. QR reminder: Vinny invites people to scan if nobody has requested anything for a number of tracks.
h.help.memoire: Tracks rated “They’re dancing” / “Emptying the floor” and today’s log.
h.help.camera: Measures motion on the dance floor, nothing is recorded (beta).
h.help.qr: The QR code to show guests so they can request songs.
h.help.souhaits: Songs guests write ahead of time, as free text.
h.help.souhaits.long: Guests type up to 3 songs (title and artist) on the wishes page: it’s free text, with no Spotify search on their side, so it works even days before the party. Identical wishes are grouped (×2, ×3…). On the night, click 🔎 Search: that’s when Spotify is queried (Spotify must be connected), then ＋ Queue or ⏫ to add it. Nothing is added to the music on its own. An event is optional: without one, wishes go under “No event” with the usual QR code.
h.help.evenements: Optional: a dated sheet with its own link, QR code and wishes.
h.help.evenements.long: Optional: without an event, you start the party and guests scan the usual QR code. Create an event only to send a link BEFORE the party: it has its date, times, place, language, code and wish list. Guests who scan early see “upcoming” and can send their wishes; once it’s over, they see your thank-you message. It activates itself at the scheduled time if “automatic opening” is checked, or you start/end it by hand.
set.title: Settings
set.LOCK_MINUTES.help: 0 = never. Locks the dashboard after this long without any activity.
set.intro: These values are stored in the app (data/settings.json) and take precedence over the .env file. The password, port, session secret and Apple keys stay in the .env.
set.savedReload: Settings saved: reload the page for the music source
set.MUSIC_PROVIDER.help: Spotify (Premium) or Apple Music. Reload the page after a change.
set.SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.help: developer.spotify.com/dashboard. The Redirect URI must be the dashboard address (http://127.0.0.1:3000/host).
set.PUBLIC_URL.help: Empty = detected local network address. On the VPS: https://your-domain
set.MAX_PENDING_PER_GUEST.help: How many requests from the same guest can wait in the queue.
set.REQ_PER_PERIOD.help: Limit per guest device (plus a wide cap per IP address, since guests on the same Wi-Fi share one), reset each period.
set.TTS_MODEL.help: E.g. elevenlabs/eleven-v3 or fish-audio/s2.1-pro-free (announcements use the model in announce/fr.json and announce/en.json).
set.TTS_BASE_URL.help: E.g. http://127.0.0.1:8020/v1 for an OpenAI-compatible server.
